violations.title: Mechanical Warewashing, Sanitization Pressure
violations.observation: The pressure gauge for the high temperature warewashing machine was below 15 PSI .
violations.corrective_action: The flow pressure of the fresh hot water sanitizing rinse in a warewashing machine shall be within the range specified on the machine manufacturer's data plate and may not be less than 15 PSI or more than 30 PSI as measured in the water line immediately downstream or upstream from the fresh hot water sanitizing rinse control valve.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Warewashing Machine Operated per Data Plate
violations.observation: The mechanical warewashing machine was not operating in accordance with the manufacturer's specifications. The sanitizing pressure was noted to be only 10 PSI and the wash temperature was fluctuating from 151F and 145F. Suds were also noted in the machine after completion of the cycles.
violations.corrective_action: A warewashing machine and its auxiliary components shall be operated in accordance with the machine's data plate and other manufacturer's instructions. Make repairs or adjustments to the machine to ensure proper operation.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Plumbing connections at the electronic operating hand wash sink located next to the dish washing machine is not operating properly. This sink is not providing water, when checked.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. Both hot and cold water must be available at all hand Sinks for employees to properly wash their hands. If the water is mixed, it must be at least 100F.
